how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, in two steps, through the CPCB website:

Step 1 – Registration: Visit www.cpcb.gov.in, go to the "Jobs" section, and register with a valid E-mail ID and active mobile number (both must be preserved till the end of the recruitment process). Enter the Name exactly as per the degree certificate (this field cannot be edited after registration), select the Post and Essential Qualification from the dropdown, and enter Date of Birth. Note down the generated Registration Number.

Step 2 – Application Submission: Log in using the Registration Number and Date of Birth (which also serves as the password). Fill in post selection, qualification and experience details as per the advertisement; upload JPEG images of photo and signature, and the Experience Certificate. Recheck all entries before final submission.
After submission, confirm the application status shows "submitted" - incomplete applications will not be considered, and CPCB will not be responsible for incomplete applications.

Applicants required to upload only scanned copies of: (i) Experience Certificate(s), (ii) copy of PhD discipline (if applicable), and (iii) the page showing the applicant's name as author/co-author of any published Paper/Book/Journal; the same must also be produced at the time of interview.
Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.
Applications, once submitted, cannot be altered, resubmitted, or deleted under any circumstances - candidates are advised to keep all data ready before starting the online form.

content_sections.text: There is no application fee for applying to any of the 51 posts under this CPCB Recruitment 2026 notification, for candidates of any category.

content_sections.heading: CPCB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Recruitment will be made through interview, subject to document verification . Relevant documents, mark-sheets and experience certificates will be verified, and screening will be carried out. In case a large number of candidates apply for a position, the Selection/Screening Committee has discretion to shortlist candidates for interview based on a written exam, percentage of marks, desirable qualification/relevant experience, higher qualification, or any other criteria it deems fit. Only candidates qualifying the document verification and screening criteria will be called for interview by a Selection Committee. Candidates must bring original mark sheets, degrees, testimonials, date-of-birth certificates, experience certificates, self-attested photocopies of each document, Aadhaar card (or other Govt.-approved photo ID), and one passport-size photo for document verification. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview, which will be held in Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. What is CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Central Pollution Control Board for 51 contract posts (Scientist-D, Scientist-C, Scientist-B, Assistant Manager Finance, Administrative Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Taxonomist, Data Entry Operator, and Field Assistant) under the SER-Phase-III Project on River Ganga.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 7 September 2026 at 23:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee for CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any of the 51 posts.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply for more than one post in CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, an applicant can apply for multiple posts if he/she fulfils the eligibility criteria for each post, but must apply separately for each one.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation in CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. As per the official FAQs, there is no age relaxation for in-service candidates, Ex-servicemen, or weaker sections/reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through interview, subject to document verification and screening. If a large number of candidates apply, the Screening Committee may shortlist candidates for interview using a written exam or other criteria before the final interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Scientist-B, Scientist-C and Scientist-D posts under CPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Scientist-D carries Rs. 1,71,597/- per month, Scientist-C carries Rs. 1,48,997/- per month, and Scientist-B carries Rs. 1,25,380/- per month, all on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the interviews for CPCB Recruitment 2026 be held?
faq.answer: Interviews will be held in Delhi. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview.
